# IBRA

Hebrew spelling and pronunciation: איברה (ee-BRA).

> IBRA is an iOS app (Hebrew-first) that runs the workout and nutrition plan your own AI chat (ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini) wrote: a daily player for sets, rest and meals, body measurements and photos, and a weekly close that sends what really happened back to the chat for adjustments. No account, no server; data stays on the phone and in the user's iCloud. One free sample day without signing up. Pricing: the first month is free (four weekly closes), then ₪199.90/year or ₪29.90/month, everything included; the AI chat is billed separately by its provider. Separately from price, the user gives "their word" (a goal, sessions per week, a weekly sign-off); two missed closes lead to renewing the word, with no fee and no data loss. Cancelling never locks data.

- Home (Hebrew): https://ibra.fit/
